summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the Phase-1 feature sprint (mobile 390x844, preview URL). PASSED: (1) Coach login -> Dashboard renders Coach banner, 'Welcome back, Coach', QuickAddGrid (3 tiles), StreakCard, MY STATS grid, zero console errors. (2) QuickAdd navigation: quick-add-drill -> /drills, quick-add-meal -> /nutrition (verified), quick-add-match tile present & wired to /track. (3) Nav drawer contains nav-item-drills for both coach and player roles. (4) Drills CRUD end-to-end: empty state -> add-drill-toggle -> drill-type-forehand + drill-intensity-high + duration 45 -> save -> drill-item row rendered, week stats updated to Drills 1 / Time 45 / High 1; survives full page reload (localStorage persist); delete + confirm removes row and restores empty state. (5) Nutrition: MacroDonut card with "Today's Macros" + 'Log a meal to see your macro split' empty state, water-tracker card, WeeklyAverageCard with 3 tiles (0/7 days logged). Water math verified: 500+500+250 = 1250/2500 ml, 50%, 7-day avg 179ml; 'Reset today' + confirm -> 0/2500 ml, 0%. (6) Player role (created via signup): skill-radar-card renders with empty state text, digest-preview renders with 'No sessions this week yet.', recent-5-strip correctly absent with no matches. (7) With 2 seeded matches: recent-5-strip + 2 recent-item-* rows, digest tiles Matches 2 / W-L 1-1 / Win Rate 50% / Practices 0 + streak line. (8) MatchDetail (/history/m_seed_1): match-skill-rating card renders; rated all 6 skills at 8, save-skill-ratings -> 'Feeds your Dashboard Skill Radar' collapsed summary with Avg 8.0; persisted to localStorage key tt.skills.<uid>; Dashboard SkillRadarCard then renders the 6-axis radar (non-empty) with 50% win rate. (9) Compare page: h2h-insight renders 'Rival One, 2 matches played, 1-1, EVEN, Last: 4-6, 3-6 (L)'. (10) LogTodayReminder: hidden before 18:00 (correct); with Playwright clock frozen at 19:30 the banner appears for a day with no logged session, and reminder-dismiss-btn hides it and writes sessionStorage tt.reminderDismissed=<today>. (11) Regressions OK: menu + bell icons rgb(255,255,255), avatar bg rgb(51,112,255) with 'CR', notifications dropdown closes on outside click and menu-toggle-btn still opens the drawer afterwards. (12) Zero JS console errors across /, /compare, /nutrition, /drills, /messages, /profile, /history/<id>. FAIL/ISSUE: inline CSS colors in the new components are double-wrapped hsl() and therefore invalid, so accent colors silently fall back (drill intensity badge, QuickAddGrid icon tints, SkillRadar polygon, MacroDonut slice colors).

ui_bugs.issue: Inline style uses `hsl(var(--color-destructive) / 0.15)` but --color-destructive is already a full hsl() color (defined in src/styles/app-tailwind.css:22 as hsl(var(--app-destructive))). Result is invalid CSS: computed color = rgb(255,255,255), background = rgba(0,0,0,0) -> the Low/Medium/High badge has no colour coding at all.

Same double-wrapped hsl() at lines 83/85 -> icon wrapper background is transparent (expected primary/chart tint) and icon colour falls back to white instead of primary/chart-3/chart-4. All 3 tiles look identical/monochrome.

Radar stroke/fill use hsl(var(--color-primary)) (invalid) so the radar polygon renders near-black instead of blue on the dark theme (visible in screenshot: dark grey hexagon). PolarRadiusAxis tick labels (0,2,4,6,8,10) also render stacked horizontally through the middle of the chart, overlapping the polygon.

Slice colours use the same invalid hsl(var(--color-primary|chart-3|chart-4)) strings, so with real meal data the donut segments will render black/uncoloured (code review; empty state was the only state reachable without logging a meal).
DashboardPage does not pass onCta, so the empty state shows no CTA link (skill-radar-cta count = 0). Spec expected an 'empty state with CTA'.

issues: PlayerBanner renders an almost empty card containing only the word 'PLAYER' for a freshly signed-up player with no links - wasted vertical space above the fold
No 'My Matches' / 'Players' tabs exist (test request assumed tabs); page is a flat match list + H2H card. Not a defect, spec/impl mismatch.
No Match History entry in the drawer for player/coach roles; /history is only reachable by deep link or other in-page links

action_items: Replace all `hsl(var(--color-*))` / `hsl(var(--color-*) / a)` inline strings with direct `var(--color-*)` or `color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-*) 15%, transparent)` in DashboardExtras.jsx (83,85), DrillsPage.jsx (204), SkillRadarCard.jsx (53-75), NutritionWidgets.jsx (18-20). NOTE: the same broken pattern is pre-existing in src/components/player/*.jsx charts - fix globally.
Pass an onCta handler (e.g. navigate to latest match detail) to SkillRadarCard on DashboardPage so the empty state exposes the documented CTA.
Fix SkillRadarCard PolarRadiusAxis tick overlap (hide ticks or set angle/tickCount) - labels currently pile up across the polygon centre.
Consider hiding/condensing the empty 'PLAYER' banner when a player has no linked coaches/parents.
critical_code_review_comments: localStore.js uses `new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)` (UTC date) for water/reminder day keys while LogTodayReminder gates on `now.getHours()` (local time). For users east/west of UTC the 'today' bucket and the 18:00 gate can disagree by a day - normalise on local date.
DrillsPage 'This week' filter uses string date comparison against a UTC-derived cutoff; fine for ISO dates but drills dated in the future are always counted - consider clamping to <= today.

MatchSkillRating existing-rating lookup does getLatestSkillRatings(user.id, 50).find(...) - O(n) scan with a hard 50 cap; a direct map lookup by matchId would be correct for users with >50 rated matches.
avgSkillRatings rounds to integers, discarding half-point averages that the radar could show (Math.round of 7.5 -> 8).

success_rate.frontend: 12/13 test cases pass; 1 fail (invalid inline hsl colours across the 4 new components)

seed_data_creation: Signed up throwaway player accounts qa.player4/5/6/7@matchtracker.app (password player123) in ephemeral browser localStorage only; seeded 2 fake matches (m_seed_1 vs Rival One W, m_seed_2 vs Rival One L) into mtp_mock_matches_v1 to exercise Recent5/Digest/MatchDetail/H2H. Nothing persists outside the test browser context. Drills created on the coach account were deleted at the end of each run; coach water log was reset to 0.
test_credentials: coach@matchtracker.app / coach123, parent@matchtracker.app / parent123 (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md). No seeded player demo account - signup flow works (Sign Up tab, #name/#email/#password/#confirm, default role = player).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation run starts with a clean localStorage, so player accounts must be re-created via signup inside the same script. Fast way to get match data: read userId from localStorage 'mtp_mock_session_v1' then write an array of match objects to 'mtp_mock_matches_v1' (fields: id,userId,date,oppName,winner('self'|'opp'),scoreSummary,sessionType,formatPreset,formatLabel,points[{pointWinner,server,set,game,...}],sets:[]) and reload - MatchDetail, Recent5, Digest and H2H all render fine from that. LogTodayReminder can only be seen with page.clock.install(time='<YYYY-MM-DD>T19:30:00Z') followed by reload. Drills/water/skill ratings live under tt.drills|water|skills.<userId>. window.confirm dialogs are used for drill delete and water reset (use page.once('dialog', accept)).
rca_of_the_issue: Tailwind v4 @theme in src/styles/app-tailwind.css defines --color-* tokens as complete colours (e.g. --color-destructive: hsl(var(--app-destructive))). The new components wrap those tokens again in hsl(), producing hsl(hsl(4 100% 62%)) which the browser discards; colour then inherits (white) and backgrounds become transparent. Verified in-browser: drill badge inlineStyle 'color: hsl(var(--color-destructive))' -> computed rgb(255,255,255), bg rgba(0,0,0,0); quick-add icon -> rgb(255,255,255) with transparent wrapper. Fix: use var(--color-x) directly, and color-mix() for alpha variants.
